stem: Voltmarkt's last-click report credits channels with €1.62 million for October, but the webshop took €1.80 million. The gap equals the revenue of orders whose customers had no touch in the 30-day window. What went wrong?

options.text: Those orders should have gone to the channel of each customer's last order
Those orders were dropped instead of being credited to an unattributed row
Those orders should have been split evenly over every channel with spend
The window should have been widened until every order had at least one touch
